info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Contact Center Insights API
info.description: The Contact Center Insights API provides users with access to detailed analytics and performance metrics related to contact center operations. It enables businesses to monitor and optimize communication channels, improving customer interactions and operational efficiency. This API primarily focuses on delivering channel-specific data and insights for contact center management. Ideal for operations teams and business analysts, it supports decision-making and strategic planning in customer service environments.

get.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific contact center management resource identified by its unique ID (RES-100045). This endpoint provides vital data relevant to operations, user metrics, and performance indicators for the specified contact center.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving data related to the contact center management operation specified by RES-100045. This body should include all necessary parameters as outlined in the schema.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the requested data.

GetContactCenterManagementByIdRequest.description: A request body string for the specific operations related to the contact center management API.

GetContactCenterManagementByIdResponse_2.title: Contact Center Management Response

channelId.description: Unique identifier for the communication channel.

regionCode.description: Code representing the region of the contact center.

serviceWindow.description: The hours during which the contact center is operational.

dailyCapacity.description: The maximum number of interactions that can be handled per day.

queueId.description: Identifier for the queue associated with this contact center.

skillGroup.description: Identifier for the skill group associated with the contact center.

targetAnswerSeconds.description: The target time, in seconds, for answering incoming requests.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the record (e.g., active, inactive).

version.description: Version number of the contact center configuration.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the contact center configuration.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the response.
